Package index

Overview

lagdynamics lagdynamics-package
lagdynamics: Lag Sequential Analysis, Dynamics, and Lag Transition Networks

Fitting models

Lag sequential analysis of sequences or event logs at one lag or at several, with a choice of engine.

lsa() lsa_classical() lsa_two_cell() lsa_bidirectional() lsa_parallel_dominance() lsa_nonparallel_dominance()
Fit a lag sequential analysis model
lsa_lags() print(<lsa_lags>) as.data.frame(<lsa_lags>)
Fit lag sequential analysis models at several lags

Preparing data

Canonical sequence data, transition counts and expected counts under structural zeros.

lsa_data()
Convert sequence input to the canonical form used by lag sequential analysis
as.data.frame(<lsa_data>) print(<lsa_data>)
Read the events of canonical sequence data as a table
lsa_transitions() print(<lsa_transitions>) as.data.frame(<lsa_transitions>)
Count transitions at a given lag
lsa_ipf()
Fit expected counts with structural zeros by iterative proportional fitting

Reading results

Tidy tables of a fitted model, one row per transition, state or test.

transitions()
Read the transitions of a fit or an inference result
nodes()
Read the states of a lag sequential analysis fit
tests()
Read the tablewise tests of independence of a fit
initial()
Read the initial-state distribution of a fit
transition_probabilities()
Read the transition probabilities of a fit
lag_profile()
Trace one transition across lags
print(<lsa_group>) print(<lsa>) summary(<lsa>) print(<summary.lsa>) as.data.frame(<summary.lsa>) as.data.frame(<lsa>) as.data.frame(<lsa_group>) summary(<lsa_group>) nobs(<lsa>)
Print, summarise and tidy a lag sequential analysis fit

Evaluating transitions

Uncertainty, stability, reliability and a permutation null for the transitions of a fit.

bootstrap_lsa()
Estimate bootstrap confidence intervals for transitions
certainty_lsa() print(<lsa_certainty>) as.data.frame(<lsa_certainty_group>) print(<lsa_certainty_group>)
Compute the analytic certainty of transition probabilities
stability_lsa()
Assess the case-drop stability of significant transitions
reliability_lsa() print(<lsa_reliability_group>) print(<lsa_reliability>)
Estimate the split-half reliability of a lag transition network
as.data.frame(<lsa_reliability>) as.data.frame(<lsa_reliability_group>)
Read the tables of a split-half reliability result
permute_lsa()
Test transitions against no sequential structure by permutation
print(<lsa_bootstrap>) print(<lsa_permutation>) print(<lsa_stability>) as.data.frame(<lsa_bootstrap>) as.data.frame(<lsa_permutation>) as.data.frame(<lsa_stability>)
Print and read resampling results

Comparing groups

Transition-level differences between groups by permutation or by a Bayesian Dirichlet-multinomial contrast.

compare_lsa()
Compare transition structures between groups with a permutation test
bayes_compare_lsa() print(<lsa_bayes>) print(<lsa_bayes_pairwise>)
Compare transition probabilities between groups with a Bayesian model
as.data.frame(<lsa_comparison>) as.data.frame(<lsa_comparison_pairwise>) print(<lsa_comparison>) print(<lsa_comparison_pairwise>)
Read the tables of a group comparison

Plots

Residual heatmaps, lag transition networks, chord diagrams, sunbursts, uncertainty forests and comparison plots.

plot(<lsa>) plot(<lsa_group>)
Plot a lag sequential analysis fit
plot_transitions()
Plot a lag transition network
plot_chords()
Plot a chord diagram of transitions
plot_polar()
Plot a polar sunburst of transitions
plot_forest() plot(<lsa_bootstrap>)
Plot a circular forest of bootstrap confidence intervals
plot(<lsa_certainty>)
Plot credible intervals of transition probabilities
plot(<lsa_comparison>) plot(<lsa_comparison_pairwise>)
Plot a comparison of transitions between groups

Beyond LSA

Directed information transfer between states, and hand-off to transition network analysis.

transfer_entropy()
Estimate directed transfer entropy between categorical sequences
lsa_to_tna()
Convert a lag sequential analysis fit to a transition network for tna

Engines

The registry of test engines, open to user-defined engines.

list_lsa_engines()
List the registered engines
get_lsa_engine()
Retrieve a registered engine
register_lsa_engine()
Register a lag sequential analysis engine
unregister_lsa_engine()
Remove a registered engine

Data

Engagement states, collaborative regulation and human-AI programming sessions.

engagement
Engagement states of students over time
group_regulation
Regulation actions in collaborative learning, as sequences
group_regulation_long
Regulation actions in collaborative learning, as an event log
ai_long
Coded AI behaviours in human-AI programming sessions
